title: Mascarpone Dessert Pizza
steps: Prepare the dough as you would regular pizza dough and divide into four dough balls.
Shape each ball into a thick 6–7-inch round with finger impressions. Coat with olive oil, add 6–8 dollops mascarpone and top with 2 Tbsp pine nuts.
Bake in a live-fire oven that has fallen from pizza heat to around 600°F.
Quarter or halve; finish with crème fraîche, powdered sugar and fresh fruit.
